text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Tamamo Cross enters scrimmage after
scrimmage,
working hard to refine the
lightning within.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Dash!

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
A'ight, I'm right on their tails. Now I just
gotta
wait till the timing's juuust right...

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text: Now! Grrraaaaah!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Her racing style is slowly starting to take
form,
when one day...

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text: Oh! What's up, squirt? Anythin' new?

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
Huh?! Whatcha cryin' for?! C'mon, calm
down
now. So what's goin' on?

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
Mom's... not movin'? And she looks
different from
when she's sleepin'?

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
Where's Dad? If you can't reach him, call
an
ambulance! Or find a grown-up!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
We cancel the day's training and
anxiously await
more news from her
family...

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text: Trainer, sorry 'bout training today...

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
She said she's feelin' stable enough.
Apparently,
her stomach was twistin' 'n
turnin'.

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
The doctor said she's gonna be fine, but
I wonder,
y'know...

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text: It's not... gonna get worse, right? I... I...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I do my best to reassure her. If her mom's

condition has stabilized, there shouldn't
be
anything to worry about.
choice_data_list: It'll be fine, if that's what the doctor says.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I'm more worried about Tamamo Cross.
I've never
seen her eyes look so
anxious... so vulnerable.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Along with the rest of her family,
Tamamo Cross's
mother means the world
to her.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Two days later, on the day of the
scrimmage...

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
(I wonder how mom's doin'... She's
probably
nappin' 'bout now.)

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
(Ugh, I can't keep worryin' like this!
Focus, focus!)

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
No... When did they get me
surrounded?! Tch, get
your head back in
the game, ya dummy!

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
Aha! An opening! Time put the pedal to
the
metal!

text_block_list.name: Umamusume A
text_block_list.text: Wh-whoa! Watch out!

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text: ...Huh?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Tumble, tumble, crashhh!

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text: Aaaaargh!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
It all happens in an instant. The
Umamusume in
front of Tamamo Cross
crash into one another,
taking her down
with them as they fall head over
heels.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Perhaps if Tamamo Cross was completely
focused
on the race, she could've
swerved out of the way.
However...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Wee woo, wee woo...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The other trainers and I spring into
action and get
all the racers medical
attention. Luckily, no one
has any
serious physical injuries... but the same

can't be said of their spirits.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Tamamo Cross herself was hit hard. After
being
given the green light to talk to
her, I rush over to
check she's okay.

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text: Gyaaah, stop! Don't come near me!

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text: Oh, it's you, Trainer... Sorry 'bout that...

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text: That race... It's over now, right? All those bodies... crashin' into each so fast... I... We...

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
Look... I think I need some space for a
while...
Sorry.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I'm told she has full-body contusions.
Basically,
she took a beating, and she's
got the bruises to
show for it. It'll take
some time for her to recover.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
But her body isn't the only thing that got

bruised...

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
(This is my chance! Go, go, gooo! I gotta
go now!)

text_block_list.name: Racing Umamusume
text_block_list.text: Gyaaaah!

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text: Ngh... Urk!

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
I'm sorry... I really am, Trainer. I knew I
had to go.
I knew I needed to make that
push.

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
I knew, but... I couldn't move. My legs
just
wouldn't budge... so I ended up
takin' the long
way around...

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
But that slowed me down too much. I
knew I
wasn't gonna make it, but then I
remembered
what happened before...

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
...Yeah. It's not like that kinda thing
happens
often. I know that, but... I just...
Urk...

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
My legs won't budge no matter how
much I
scream at them to freakin' MOVE!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The collision has stricken fear into her
heart and
reduced the lightning she
once boasted to a
humble spark.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
No doubt her worries regarding her
family are
what distracted Tamamo
Cross. Her judgment was
only delayed
by a moment, but the lasting

consequences are bearing down heavily
on her...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
At this rate, every race she enters for the
time
being is going to wear away more
and more of her
energy.
